root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `isValidBoxFileType()` may read `minorVersion` from `boxData.data() + 4`, it must establish `boxData.size() >= 8` so the fixed-width file-type fields are fully present.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the `minorVersion` read on a 4-byte file-type payload because the unsigned modulo check omits the minimum-size guard. The fixed original is guarded on the stock PoC, and the closest boundary witness `ftyp_payload8` executes the same protected read with `boxData.size() == 8`.

nodes.description: At the source-level unsafe read, the pointer passed for `minorVersion` is exactly one past the 4-byte `boxData` allocation end.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `minor_version_ptr == box_end_ptr`, showing the `minorVersion` read starts at the end of the undersized payload buffer.

edges.relation: The one-past-end `minorVersion` pointer created in `isValidBoxFileType()` is passed unchanged into `Exiv2::getULong()` as `buf`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `minor_version_read.minor_version_ptr == get_ulong_entry.buf_ptr` for the crashing call.
